backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing comment list management with single-use device tracking, bulk comment generation with access key verification, admin functions for list creation/deletion, and blob storage integration for media uploads.

frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON summaries of all frontend components, pages, hooks, and configuration files for the application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring React Query, theme provider, and TanStack Router with routes for customer view, upload section, live list checker, and admin panel with token gate.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminChatT: Admin tab component for adding and viewing chat messages with sender input, message input, send button, and scrollable message history with timestamps.

frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSetti: Admin UI component for managing the bulk generator access key: view current status with masked key, set new key, and reset key with confirmation.
